description: Estimate the input and output token cost of a prompt across a list of model prices. When choosing a model or sizing a prompt budget. Do not choose this when you need exact tokenizer counts, which needs the model's tokenizer. Example requests: Estimate the token cost of this prompt across these models. | What will this prompt cost at this volume? | Compare model prices for this prompt.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

models.description: The customer's models.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One 'model,input_per_1k,output_per_1k' per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

prompt.description: The customer's prompt.txt, as text. Supported: Free text. The prompt to cost. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

volume.description: The customer's volume.txt, as text. Supported: An integer. Calls per period. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_token_cost_estimator

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Token cost estimator
